comments_content_check.name: comments_content_check
comments_content_check.value: ("comments"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND char_length("comments"."content") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR ("comments"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "comments"."content" = '')

comments_author_check.name: comments_author_check
comments_author_check.value: "comments"."author_id" IS NOT NULL OR "comments"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL

follows_town_lot_check.name: follows_town_lot_check
follows_town_lot_check.value: "follows"."town_lot" IS NULL OR ("follows"."town_lot" BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND "follows"."is_favorite")

notifications_shape_check.name: notifications_shape_check
notifications_shape_check.value: ("notifications"."kind" = 'level_up' AND "notifications"."level" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."actor_id" IS NULL AND "notifications"."post_id" IS NULL) OR ("notifications"."kind" <> 'level_up' AND "notifications"."level" IS NULL AND "notifications"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."post_id" IS NOT NULL)

posts_subcategory_check.name: posts_subcategory_check
posts_subcategory_check.value: "posts"."subcategory_id" IS NULL OR "posts"."category_id" IS NOT NULL

replies_content_check.name: replies_content_check
replies_content_check.value: ("replies"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND char_length("replies"."content") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR ("replies"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "replies"."content" = '')
